# Practice with Coding Exercises

#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Practice with Coding Exercises

Now that you have completed the first chapter, we highly recommend you take our complementary course, Practice: C++ Basics.

The course is created to help you practice with real-world examples and build confidence in your skills.

![Practice: C++ Introduction ](data:image/png;base64,)

Each chapter of Practice: C++ Basics corresponds directly to a chapter of Learn C++ Basics. This structure allows you to immediately apply what you've learned and switch between learning and practice.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

Note that the practice course doesn't include solutions. If you get stuck on any practice problem, revisit the relevant concept in this course and try the problem again.

Remember, the only way to learn programming is to write lots of code.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
